notes.text: The letter is dated Massy le 3.11.1970 and addressed Cher Deligne. It asks whether Deligne has finished looking at Rim’s SGA 7 VI exposé and requests its return with comments; otherwise it asks whether and when he intends to look at it. This is a report of the source wording, not an external historical verification.
notes.basis: Observation: date, salutation, and first body paragraph.

notes.text: The writer says he has asked Mlle Altazin, who typed Deligne’s SGA 4 XVIII exposé, to send it with the manuscript for correction. He asks whether it has arrived and whether Deligne intends to make the corrections; after they are done, or if Deligne does not want to do them, he requests the clean text. The unusual spelling envoyes moi is visibly typed and retained.
notes.basis: Observation: second body paragraph, especially its last source line.
